ALEX SAMPSON - HOPELESS ROMANTIC
Pop • 2024 • Dolby Atmos
Artist: Alex Sampson
Album: Hopeless Romantic
Format: Dolby Atmos, m4a [EAC3-JOC, 16bit/48kHz, 768Kbps, 5.1s]
Click to expand...
Released on September 27, 2024, Hopeless Romantic is the sophomore EP from Toronto-based singer-songwriter Alex Sampson, marking his first project written entirely from start to finish. The EP's rollout was heavily influenced by Sampson’s successful run on Season 19 of America’s Got Talent, where he reached the semi-finals performing lead singles like "Pretty Baby" and "If You Were My Girl." Despite falling short of the AGT finals, Sampson channeled that momentum into the release, even dropping the fan-favorite track "Wallflower" early to honor his journey on the show and provide a bridge to this highly personal collection of songs.
